title: DeltaTTG: Training Multi-Turn Agents with a Token-to-Go Progress Meter
title_zh: DeltaTTG：利用 Token-to-Go 进度计训练多轮智能体
abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for multi-turn agents relies on sparse terminal rewards that say little about individual steps. Within-group step comparisons depend on reliable state matching and sufficiently diverse sampled outcomes, while direct step scoring may require costly external evaluators, human annotations, or task-specific heuristics. We introduce DeltaTTG to learn a reusable progress signal through a shared progress meter, using low-cost supervision from diverse policies' recorded trajectories without task-specific progress rules. Its supervision target, Token-to-Go (TTG), the number of tokens remaining to be generated until task completion, serves as an observable proxy for remaining completion effort. During actor training, changes in the frozen meter's estimates redistribute outcome-derived advantages across steps without altering the reward, preserving each trajectory's advantage sign and token-average scale. On ALFWorld, PaperSearchQA, and BFCLv3, DeltaTTG improves the average score over GRPO by 5.7 and 7.2 points with Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, respectively, outperforms all compared RL baselines on average, and keeps actor-training GPU-hours close to GRPO. Further experiments show improved sample efficiency and out-of-domain performance, and support the meter's ability to distinguish step quality and guide test-time action selection across actor sizes. The code is available at https://github.com/Xuyan923r/DeltaTTG.
abstract_zh: 针对多轮智能体强化学习中稀疏终止奖励难以评估单步贡献的问题，论文提出 DeltaTTG。该方法通过共享进度计学习可复用的任务进展信号，并利用不同策略记录的轨迹，以无需任务特定规则的低成本监督训练进度计。其监督目标 Token-to-Go（TTG）表示任务完成前仍需生成的 token 数量，作为剩余完成难度的可观测代理。在 actor 训练时，冻结的进度计根据进展估计变化，将基于最终结果的优势重新分配到各步骤，同时保持奖励、轨迹优势符号和 token 平均尺度不变。在 ALFWorld、PaperSearchQA 和 BFCLv3 上，使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 时，相比 GRPO 平均得分分别提升 5.7 和 7.2 分；该方法平均超过其他对比强化学习基线，而 actor 训练 GPU 小时数接近 GRPO。实验还表明，DeltaTTG 能提升样本效率、域外泛化能力，并可区分步骤质量、指导不同规模 actor 的测试时动作选择。
key_points_zh: 提出共享进度计，通过 Token-to-Go（TTG）预测完成任务所需的剩余 token 数，学习通用的步骤进展信号。
利用多样策略的历史轨迹进行低成本监督，无需外部评估器、人工标注或任务特定进度规则。
在不改变原始奖励、轨迹优势符号和 token 平均尺度的前提下，将终局优势更合理地分配到各个步骤。
在 ALFWorld、PaperSearchQA 和 BFCLv3 上显著优于 GRPO 及其他强化学习基线，同时保持接近 GRPO 的训练计算成本。
DeltaTTG 还能提升样本效率和域外泛化，并支持步骤质量判断与测试时动作选择。

llm_assessment.comment: DeltaTTG introduces a reusable progress estimator that converts trajectory-level outcomes into stable multi-turn credit signals without task-specific progress rules.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: DeltaTTG提出了可复用的进度估计器，在无需任务特定规则的情况下将轨迹级结果转化为稳定的多轮信用信号。
